uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: While at 50% max HP or below: increases Attack and Sp. Atk by 20%. When the Pokémon is at half HP or less, its Attack and Sp. Attack are increased.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, reducing the cooldowns of the user's moves by 1s; damaging opposing Pokémon 3 times over 0.2s, and decreasing their movement speed by 50% for 1s when hit. Boosted attacks used during Rapid Spin hit 3 times over 0.5s, do not reduce the cooldowns of the user's moves, nor decrease the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit. When evolving into Blastoise, basic attacks hit once, but deals damage as 2 instances of 50% Attack. Blastoise’s third auto attack is empowered - dealing 3 instances of damage, slowing enemies hit and reducing Blastoise’s move cooldowns by 1 second each.
Blastoise’s third auto attack is empowered - dealing 3 instances of damage, slowing enemies hit and reducing Blastoise’s move cooldowns by 1 second each.

Shoots a jet of water in the designated direction after 0.2s, damaging opposing Pokémon hit, shoving them for 0.6s and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 1s when hit. Opposing Pokémon hit before the jet of water reaches halfway are shoved the full distance; those hit beyond halfway are shoved a short distance instead. Attacks with a shot of water, shoving enemies and decreasing their movement speed for a short time.

Blasts out a huge amount of water in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit 3 times in 0.1s, shoving them and stunning them for 0.6s when hit. Opposing Pokémon hit before the blast of water reaches halfway are shoved the full distance; those hit beyond halfway are shoved a short distance instead. When used during Rapid Spin: Blastoise unleashes a large burst of water in a radius around themself, damaging enemies, knocking them back and stunning those hit for 0.75s. Blastoise also gains a 30% movement speed bonus for the duration of this move. Has the user attack by blasing out a huge volume of water, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and shoving them when it hits.
Increased move damage. Increases damage dealt by this move.

Casts down a barrage of water at the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 0.5s over 3s (up to 6 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s when hit. When used during Rapid Spin: increases movement speed by 30%, and rapidly spouts bursts of water in different directions around themself, damaging opposing over time when held for the duration of Rapid Spin (up to a possible 17 times). The first hit of Water Spout during Rapid Spin on an opposing Pokémon decreases the target's movement speed; subsequent hits will not. Spouts water toward the designated location, decreasing the movement speed of opposing Pokémon in the area of effect for a short time.
Increased move damage. Increases damage dealt by this move.
Tucks in their head then dashes forward after 0.5s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the path and stunning them for 0.5s when it hits. Fiercely rams an opposing Pokémon and leaves it unable to act.

Blastoise rides a wave of water, becoming Unstoppable for 1.6s. Blastoise can then jump off the wave in the designated direction, while the wave continues to travel. Blastoise gains a shield if the wave damages a Pokemon. Enemy Pokemon that make contact with the wave take damage and are stunned and shoved for 1.6s. The wave can be stopped by walls, and will deal no damage once Blastoise has jumped off. Has the user charge forward on a wave, shoving enemies and leaving them unable to act. The user becomes immune to hindrances while using this move and can jump in a designated direction once this move ends.
Increases the strength of the shield. Also grants a shield when this move hits.

Withdraws into their shell, resetting the cooldown of Hydro Pump or Water Spout and gaining hindrance resistance for the duration of this move; then starts rapidly spinning while moving freely for up to 5s or when used again to stop spinning and end this move. Damages opposing Pokémon in contact with the user every 0.5s while spinning (up to 10 times). While spinning: changes the mechanics of auto attacks and Hydro Pump or Water Spout. When this move ends: comes out of their shell and readies a boosted attack. The user cannot perform any actions for 0.45s while withdrawing or coming out of their shell. Has the user spin rapidly, changing the mechanics of its basic attacks as well as its Hydro Pump and Water Spout moves.
Increases Defense and Sp. Def while using this move. Also reduces the damage the user receives while using this move.

Becomes unstoppable for 2s and gains a shield for 4s; shoots immense jets of water in a large circle around themself after 1.1s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing them for 1.5s when it hits. Has the user spout water to attack while spinning, throwing enemies in a large area. This also grants the user a shield.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

damageFormula.trueDescription: Withdraws into their shell, resetting the cooldown of Hydro Pump or Water Spout and gaining hindrance resistance for the duration of this move; then starts rapidly spinning while moving freely for up to 5s or when used again to stop spinning and end this move. Damages opposing Pokémon in contact with the user every 0.5s while spinning (up to 10 times).
damageFormula.notes: While spinning: changes the mechanics of auto attacks and Hydro Pump or Water Spout. When this move ends: comes out of their shell and readies a boosted attack. The user cannot perform any actions for 0.45s while withdrawing or coming out of their shell.
